root_cause.text: The `xe_oa_add_config_ioctl()` function in the `drm/xe/oa` subsystem accesses the `oa_config` structure after releasing the `oa->metrics_lock` mutex that protects its lifetime, creating a race condition where a concurrent call to `xe_oa_remove_config_ioctl()` can free the structure before it is dereferenced.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `mutex_unlock(&oa->metrics_lock)` was moved to occur after caching `oa_config->id` and calling `drm_dbg(&oa->xe->drm, "Added config %s id=%i\n", oa_config->uuid, id)`, and the return value was changed from `oa_config->id` to the cached `id` variable.
